title: Penny
tagline: Meet Penny, your go-to accounting AI agent. Seamlessly managing your accounts, tracking transactions, and offering a professional dashboard
description:
Imagine you're a startup founder or business owner, drowning in paperwork and exhausted from manually managing accounts and transactions. Hiring an expensive accountant might seem like the only way out—but what if there was a smarter solution?

Meet Penny, your AI-powered financial assistant. Penny effortlessly handles payroll, generating and sending salary transactions straight to your MetaMask—whether you prefer a simple sign-off or full automation. Plus, don't let your idle funds sit idle—Penny provides AI-driven DeFi investment insights to help grow your wealth.

Simplify your finances. Maximize your earnings. Let Penny do the heavy lifting.
how_its_made:
This project is built with:

Frontend:
Next.js as the React framework.
Tailwind CSS for styling.
Backend:
Node.js with Express for the server.
MongoDB as the database.
I attempted to integrate CDP AgentKit, but faced some challenges because it was designed to work with an agnostic wallet.
